Plasma density as one scale factor on the four species peaks. n_D0 is the declared lever; n_T0, n_e0, n_He0 ride with it as declared ties: quasineutrality at the peak (n_e0 = n_D0 + n_T0 + 2 n_He0 = 5.06e20 at Point A) is invariant under a common scale, so scaling the four together is the only consistent way to move density (executor's declaration from the Table 5 image, Item 6 design D7).

Peak ion and electron temperature, moved together. Proposed and DECLINED by the executor (pre-execution critique): the package has no confinement or ignition closure, so temperature is a free input nothing pushes back on; it is held at Point A (14.63 / 15.40 keV) and the density sweep is therefore a fixed-temperature pressure sweep. Declared for its indicator.
